title: Conditional Instruction Block
statement: Read a boolean-like string 'true' or 'false' indicating whether verbose mode is on, then a base instruction. If verbose, print the instruction followed by ' Explain your reasoning step by step.' on the same line; otherwise print the instruction unchanged.
starter_code:
verbose = input().strip() == 'true'
instruction = input()
